relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: In this open-label study, galcanezumab was generally well tolerated and improved patient-reported cluster headache status.

key_findings: Galcanezumab 300 mg was generally well tolerated over long-term in 164 cluster headache patients; 72.6% had TEAEs, mostly mild-moderate
At least 81% reported improvement on PGI-I at Months 1, 6 and 12
